# Data notice

Eight daily drilling and well-operation reports (HTML) from Volve's `Well_technical_data`,
as published: F-12's wireline job of November 2014 (a water shut-off plug and a new zone
perforated), F-12's production log and bridge plug of September 2010, and F-14's plug of
January 2012. A test fixture for `wellpilot.ingest.operations` and the `well_operations`
tool.

Contains data from the Volve field dataset, made available by Equinor and the former Volve
license partners (ExxonMobil Exploration & Production Norway AS, Bayerngas Norge AS) under
the Equinor Open Data Licence:
https://www.equinor.com/content/dam/statoil/documents/what-we-do/Equinor-HRS-Terms-and-conditions-for-licence-to-data-Volve.pdf
